fact: On 29 April 2022 Togo inaugurated the Centre d'information policière du Togo as the national centre for collecting and recording police data and managing WAPIS, funded by the European Union under ECOWAS and implemented by INTERPOL; workstations had been deployed in Lomé and installed in units of the National Police, Customs, the Gendarmerie and the OCRTIDB, with no deployment outside Lomé and no count of units stated.
title: THE TOGO POLICE INFORMATION SYSTEM, A MAJOR ASSET FACING THE CHALLENGES OF TRANSNATIONAL ORGANIZED
